The latest biweekly reading of the Penta-CivicScience Economic Sentiment Index (ESI) increased 1.5 points to 32.3—partially reversing the decline in the previous period—despite persistent inflation and signs of a weakening labor market.

Overall 8-12Four of the ESI's five indicators increased during this period. Confidence in the overall U.S. economy increased the most, rising 3.4 points to 31.4.
